Build Yourself. Build Society.

Why Leader-BEE?

Leader-BEE is a fun, interactive 10-week leadership journey where children develop essential life skills through games, activities, teamwork, discussions, and practical experiences.

The program also encourages active participation from parents to reinforce leadership values at home.

Program details and structure

to 10 Weeks
